hooks.name: applist_alloc
hooks.verification: stock bytes 'dc20' asserted at the site
hooks.purpose: Bump the launcher AppListView allocation 0xdc->0xfc, giving a 32-byte state tail at app+0xdc for the CFW heap-context pointer.

hooks.name: link_register_shim
hooks.verification: stock 10 bytes asserted; pointer constants asserted: [0x106d9d9c]=0x19750d2c (&file_sink), [0x106d9da0]=0x106d97f1 (stock callback), [0x10799030]=0x19a1f954 (&launcher)
hooks.purpose: Inside LinkMonitor::registerLinkCallback: call cfw_register_shim, which registers the module's RNLink callback table for business 0xF0 (rnlink_if_register_callback) and then replays the displaced stock instructions unchanged (slot [0x19750d2c+0x18] stays NULL).

hooks.name: footer_zero
hooks.verification: stock footer bytes asserted; relocated to the new end by the append patch
hooks.purpose: Zero the old 8-byte build-info footer slot so the appended module can start 32-byte aligned.

hooks.name: module_append
hooks.verification: appended at offset == stock length; module absolutely linked at module_va; patched AP <= 9600000 bytes
hooks.purpose: Append the Glassly CFW module and relocate the build-info footer to the new end.
